e.body:
**Alora - Insurance Quote Autofill**（Firefox 扩展 `alora-insurance-quote-autofill`）**是一个**把**自己的风险台账**自动填进**保险公司报价表单**的**浏览器扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Auto-fill insurance quote forms with your Alora risk ledger. Personal, Commercial, Life & Professional lines.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Mozilla 扩展登记接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**风险台账**」当成**唯一数据源****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条的核心**：**⭐ 即**同一份**风险资料**被**反复**填进**不同保险公司的**报价表单**——**⭐ 而**这**正是**经纪与**代理日常工作中**最耗时的一环**（**⭐ 多家**询价**就要**重复录入**多次）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这是**「**一份资料、**多处复用**」**的**客户端实现**，**而**其**填写质量**与**口径一致性**完全**取决于**台账本身**是否**维护得好**（**⭐ 本条**未核实**台账的**字段定义**）。**⭐⭐ ② 它按**业务线**组织，**而不是**只服务一个险种****——**⭐ 逐字自述**覆盖**「**Personal, Commercial, Life & Professional lines**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**一条**扩展**若要**真的**在**日常**里被用**，**就**必须**覆盖**使用者**手上的**多条线**——**⭐ 而**按**业务线**组织**，**也**意味着**不同线的**字段差异**要**在**产品里**被**分别处理**。**⭐⭐ ③ 创建与更新只差三天，**而**版本号已到 **2.2.0****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**创建 **2026-08-09**、**最后更新 **2026-08-12**（**⭐ 均在**解冻窗口之内**）**、**版本 **`2.2.0`**、**包体 **69,882 字节****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**信号**合起来**说明**它**是**一个**快速迭代中的**新产品**（**⭐ 本词条**同时也**如实指出**：**日活为 **0****，**故**本次**看不到**任何**实际使用**）。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 闭源、**无仓库、**支持地址**是 **`.now` 域名****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**无**仓库地址**、**支持链接逐字为 **`https://alora.now/`****、**发布者逐字为 **`alora insurance`****。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 使用者**无法**独立核实**它**把**台账里的**客户资料**发往何处**——**⭐ 而**这一点**在**浏览器扩展**里**尤其重要**（**⭐ 即**扩展**能看到**你在**任何**页面上**填的**内容**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[application-fill-provenance]] 覆盖**申请材料**的来路**、**[[quotelens-provenance]] 覆盖**报价比对的**来源**、**[[underwriting-workbench]] 覆盖**核保工作台**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**自有风险台账**自动填进**多家保险公司报价表单**的**浏览器扩展**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **录入一次、**多处复用**是**真实痛点**（**⭐ 本条**把它**做成**客户端工具**）**；**② **台账**的**字段定义**决定**填写质量**——**⭐ 故**要**先**有**口径**，**再**谈**自动化**；**③ **按**业务线**组织**比**单险种工具**更接近**日常**；**④ **浏览器扩展**能**看到**页面内容**，**故**其**数据去向**必须**可核实**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有使用**该扩展**（**未在任何**保险公司页面**上**测试**填充、**未提交任何**报价请求**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能**、**不主张**其**填充准确度**、**也**不主张**其**与**任何**保险公司的**表单兼容**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**扩展登记接口返回的**元数据**（**名称、**发布者、**版本、**日活、**许可、**包体大小与**链接字段**）**，**未读**其**包内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**声称的**四条业务线**是否**真的**被支持**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据流向**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**它**是否**上传台账数据**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**发布者**与**任何**保险中介**的**持牌关系**——**⭐ 本词条**只记录**其**自述**。**⑥ ⚠️ **日活为 **0****，**故**本条**不主张**它**已被**任何人**实际使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该扩展**不是**保险产品**，**其**填充的内容**不构成**投保申请**或**核保意见**。

**Alora - Insurance Quote Autofill**（Firefox 擴充 `alora-insurance-quote-autofill`）**是一個**把自己的風險台賬**自動填進**保險公司報價表單的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Auto-fill insurance quote forms with your Alora risk ledger. Personal, Commercial, Life & Professional lines.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Mozilla 擴充登記介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**風險台賬**」當成唯一數據源****——**⭐ 即**同一份風險資料被反覆填進不同保險公司的報價表單**——**⭐ 而這正是經紀與代理日常最耗時的一環**（**多家詢價就要重複錄入多次**）**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**這是「**一份資料、**多處複用**」的客戶端實現**，**其填寫質量取決於台賬本身**。**⭐⭐ ② 按業務線組織，**而不是只服務一個險種****——**逐字覆蓋 Personal, Commercial, Life & Professional lines**——**⭐ 即**要真的在日常被用**，**就必須覆蓋手上的多條線**。**⭐⭐ ③ 創建與更新只差三天，**而版本已到 `2.2.0`****——**創建 2026-08-09**、**最後更新 2026-08-12（**均在窗口之內**）**、**包體 69,882 位元組**——**⭐ 即**快速迭代中的新產品**（**而**日活為 0，**故**本次看不到實際使用**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 閉源、**無倉庫、**支持位址是 `.now` 域名****——**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**發布者逐字為 alora insurance****——**⭐ 即**使用者無法獨立核實它把台賬裡的客戶資料發往何處**，**而這在瀏覽器擴充裡尤其重要**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[quotelens-provenance]]、[[underwriting-workbench]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把自有風險台賬自動填進多家保險公司報價表單的瀏覽器擴充**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **錄入一次、**多處複用是真實痛點**；**② **台賬的欄位定義決定填寫質量**；**③ **按業務線組織更接近日常**；**④ **擴充能看到頁面內容，**故其數據去向必須可核實**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有使用**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能**、**填充準確度**，**也不主張**其與任何保險公司表單兼容**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀擴充登記介面返回的元資料**，**未讀**其包內容**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其聲稱的四條業務線是否真的被支持**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其數據流向**（**不推測**是否上傳台賬數據**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者與任何保險中介的持牌關係**。**⑥ ⚠️ 日活為 0**，**不主張**它已被任何人實際使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該擴充不是保險產品**。

e.body_en:
This extension **auto-fills insurers quote forms from the user own risk ledger**, described verbatim as filling insurance quote forms from a risk ledger across personal, commercial, life and professional lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Mozilla add-on registry interface**: **first, it treats one risk ledger as the single data source**, so the same risk information is filled repeatedly into different insurers quote forms. **That is precisely the most time-consuming part of a broker or agent working day, since shopping a risk around means re-entering the same data several times, and the client-side version of entering once and reusing in many places is what this extension attempts; the quality and consistency of what it fills depends entirely on how well that ledger is maintained, and this entry did not verify the ledger field definitions.** **Second, it is organised by line of business rather than serving one line**, naming personal, commercial, life and professional lines. **For an extension to be used daily it has to cover the lines the user actually handles, and organising by line also means differences between lines have to be handled separately in the product.** **Third, it was created and updated three days apart with the version already at 2.2.0.** Creation was in early August and the last update three days later, both inside the thaw window, with a package of about seventy kilobytes. **Together those read as a fast-iterating new product, and this entry also records plainly that the daily user count is zero, so no usage is visible.** **Fourth, it is closed, with no repository and a support address on a dot-now domain.** The licence reserves all rights and the publisher name suggests a related brand. **A user therefore cannot independently verify where the customer information in the ledger is sent, which matters especially for a browser extension because such an extension can see what is filled on any page.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the provenance of application material, the provenance of quote comparisons and an underwriting workbench, **while this entry supplies a browser extension that fills insurers quote forms from the user own risk ledger. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: entering data once and reusing it in many places is a real pain point, and here it is solved client-side; the ledger field definitions determine the quality of what gets filled, so definitions come before automation; organising by line of business matches daily work better than a single-line tool; and because a browser extension can read page content, where its data goes must be verifiable.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor used**, no insurer page was tested and no quote request was submitted, **so no claim is made about its functionality, its filling accuracy or its compatibility with any insurer forms**. **Second, only the metadata returned by the registry was read**, not the package contents. **Third, whether the four claimed lines of business are actually supported was not verified. Fourth, its data flow was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about whether ledger data is uploaded.** **Fifth, the publisher licensing relationship, if any, was not verified**, only its own account being recorded. **Sixth, with a daily user count of zero this entry does not claim that anyone is using it in practice. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the extension is not an insurance product and that what it fills does not constitute an application or an underwriting opinion.**
